lead: AI continues to make headlines across various sectors, from funding and technological advancements to ethical concerns and societal impacts.

stories.title: Best in Tech awards finalist Sophiie AI lands $5 million Seed round
stories.summary: Sophiie AI, a finalist in the Best in Tech awards, has secured a $5 million seed round to enhance its AI solutions aimed at transforming administrative tasks for tradespeople. This funding is expected to facilitate the company's expansion into the US market.

stories.title: Report supporting Australia’s teen social media ban appears to contain AI hallucinations, Senate hears
stories.summary: A report advocating for a social media ban for teens in Australia has been scrutinized for containing references to non-existent academic articles, raising concerns about AI-generated content. While the authors acknowledged using AI in editing, they denied that the errors were due to hallucinations from the technology.

stories.title: Microsoft blames AI for delayed Exchange update, can’t say when it will arrive
stories.summary: Microsoft has cited AI-related issues as the reason for the delayed rollout of a critical update for its Exchange service. The company is currently grappling with a backlog of machine-generated bugs, complicating its ability to deliver timely software updates.

stories.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
stories.summary: In a significant move within the tech industry, Stripe is reportedly set to acquire OpenRouter, an AI gateway startup, for over $7 billion. This acquisition highlights the growing trend of integrating AI capabilities into payment processing and financial services.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
stories.summary: OpenAI has reportedly disbanded its preparedness team, responsible for assessing risks associated with its AI models. This restructuring comes amidst significant changes within the company as it prepares for a potential IPO, raising questions about its approach to AI safety.

stories.title: Dario Amodei admits AI companies have not delivered on their promises
stories.summary: Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic, has openly acknowledged that AI companies have fallen short of their ambitious promises. He emphasizes that only genuine breakthroughs will restore public trust in AI technologies as the industry faces scrutiny ahead of major IPOs.

stories.title: Deepfake Anthony Albanese used in celebrity scams duping Australians out of $7.4m, Asic warns
stories.summary: Australia's corporate watchdog has reported a surge in scams utilizing deepfake technology, with Prime Minister Anthony Albanese being a common target. These scams have collectively defrauded Australians of approximately $7.4 million, highlighting the risks posed by advanced AI technologies.

stories.title: AI cheating, leaked papers and marking errors: how exam protests went global
stories.summary: Global student protests have erupted in response to AI-related issues in education, including cheating and exam marking errors. The unrest reflects growing frustrations among students in various countries as they navigate an increasingly competitive academic landscape.
